arm1_case_results_anomaly.root_cause: The evaluation dataset eval_5292_clean.jsonl.gz contains 4,950 unique example_id values and 342 duplicate example_ids. Arm 1 saved results with case_results[example_id] = ..., causing dictionary collisions that overwrote the 342 duplicate keys. Arms 2-5 saved results with case_results[f'{idx}_{example_id}'] = ..., preserving all 5,292 entries.
arm1_case_results_anomaly.statistical_consequence: Paired McNemar testing between Arm 1 and any other arm cannot be validly performed on N=5,292. It is strictly constrained to the N=4,950 intersection subset.

forensic_actual_count.root_cause: Naive calculation assumed all 5,292 questions had 4 options rotated 4 times. However, the 852 'Rel' questions are binary Yes/No questions and only permit 2 rotations (Yes/No and No/Yes), yielding 1,704 passes rather than 3,408 passes.
